message.reasoning: User asks: "計算冰河時期是多少年前？" They want to calculate how many years ago the ice age was. Likely they refer to the last glacial period? Or the Pleistocene? We need to interpret. The user says "計算冰河時期是多少年前？" which means "Calculate how many years ago was the ice age?" They might want the time since the last ice age ended. That ended about 11,700 years ago. But maybe they want the start of the last ice age? That started around 2.58 million years ago. But the phrase "冰河時期" could refer to the Pleistocene epoch. So we can ask clarifying question: Which ice age? The last one? Or the Pleistocene? Also ask if they want years ago or absolute dates. Provide function call. Let's ask clarifying question.
